replies.author: Matic0B
replies.body:
This is a very interesting map you have here :)

I like there is armor supplies for teams and I really like the void gap in TDM. How much diamond is there though? If its 3 blocks per side then its fine if its 10+ then I would recommend lowering it.

The middle area looks like and I like the height differences on the map overall. I would just recommend some more decorations on the 4 team islands in the walls and floor with clay patterns. That would make it look a bit nicer.

One thing im worried about is a team just camping down the middle and shooting down everyone else from their bridges after they respawn. If a team or two control the middle they could just lock down the other teams by shooting them off their bridges while they are trying to come to the middle island. Include a diamond person or a two in there and they will dominate.

Other than that its a pretty nice map and could work out nicely in public matches. Good job!
